title: The Andhra Pradesh Minorities Component (Outlay, Allocation and Utilization of Financial Resources) Act, 2022.
full_text: The Andhra Pradesh Minorities Component (Outlay, Allocation and Utilization of Financial Resources) Act, 2022. null Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20226 Act Number: 6 Enactment Date: 2022-04-20 Act Year: 2022 Short Title: The Andhra Pradesh Minorities Component (Outlay, Allocation and Utilization of Financial Resources) Act, 2022. Long Title: AN ACT TO ENSURE, ACCELERATED DEVELOPMENT OF MINORITY COMMUNITIES WITH EMPHASIS ON ACHIEVING EQUALITY IN THE NEXT TEN YEARS FOCUSING ON ECONOMIC, EDUCATIONAL AND HUMAN DEVELOPMENT ALONG WITH ENSURING THE SECURITY AND SOCIAL DIGNITY AND PROMOTING EQUITY AMONG MINORITY POPULATION, BY EARMARKING A PORTION, IN PROPORTION TO POPULATION OF MINORITIES WELFARE IN THE STATE OF THE TOTAL OUTLAY FOR CSS & SDP SCHEMES OF THE STATE OF ANDHRA PRADESH AS THE OUTLAY OF THE MINORITIES COMPONENT OF THE STATE AND ENSURING EFFECTIVE INSTITUTIONAL MECHANISMS FOR THE IMPLEMENTATION AND FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR INCIDENTAL THERETO.
